notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year, Squad![/h1]

We've pushed a new patch to the public branch. Please make sure your game has uploaded and that you see [b]v1.0.4 WIN (3240.25,0102a) [/b]on the title screen.

[h2]v1.0.4 patch notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixes bug where you could mash the shoulder buttons to brute-force your way past a locked view
[*] Team Spirit and Happy Reunion trophies now unlock properly
[*] Fixes bug where a critical patient in a locked view no longer shows its pip in the view dock
[*] Fixes title screen not respecting volume settings until you open the pause menu or go to Options
[*] Corrects a few English typos throughout the script
[/list]

Thanks for your continued support. If you're enjoying Neo Harbor Rescue Squad, [b]please leave a positive review![/b] It helps us a lot. 🙏

- Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Demo v1.0.2 Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, Squad members![/h1]

We patched the Neo Harbor Rescue Squad demo for your life-saving enjoyment.

[h2]v1.0.2 Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixes soft lock during opening scene for PCs that are running in French (and hopefully other languages!); game will no longer hang when the visual novel scenes says "(*CRASH*)"
[*] Adjusts overall game difficulty and balance
[*] Improves visual feedback for treatment scenes (patient heal/hurt)
[*] Corrects some animations during some visual novel scenes
[*] Fixes some visual bugs for various treatment minigames
[/list]

As always, if you have any issues, hit us up in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2342780/discussions/]Discussions[/url] or contact us via our [url=https://www.bancy.co/contact-support]support page[/url].

Thanks for playing!
Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Save lives in our updated demo!
notes.content:
The Neo Harbor Rescue Squad demo has been updated for Steam Next Fest! Now you can enjoy:

[list]
[*]fully localized text in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese
[*]improved controls with both controller and keyboard
[*]better feedback during treatment scenes
[*]improved options menu
[*]bug fixes and other adjustments
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who provided feedback for our first demo release.

As you may have seen, we've also announced the full game's launch date: [b]November 12, 2024![/b] Please wishlist the game today to help us get the word out to more Steam players.

Here's a new gameplay trailer to show you more of what you can expect in the full game. We can't wait for you to join our squad!

- Ben & Nancy

notes.title: NHRS Demo v0.7.240815a released to fix bugs, correct some content
notes.content:
Hey, Squad!

We pushed a patch on demo launch day (Thursday, August 15) to address some bugs with the Options menu, and to address an issue where the demo was actually showing some work-in-progress content that it shouldn't have — whoops! 

Your title screen should show [b]v0.7.240815a[/b].

[h3][h2]What's changed in v0.7.240815a[/h2]
[/h3]
[list]
[*]fixed an issue where turning off screen shake in the options could prevent progress
[*]fixed some other minor options issues / inconsistencies
[*]restored the correct demo content so you can't play some unfinished missions meant for later in the game that haven't been fully QA'ed yet
[/list]

[h3]Known issues with this version[/h3]
[list]
[*]turning the controller vibration to low or off doesn't make much difference
[*]map pins can sometimes display at the incorrect location on the map
[/list]

notes.title: Get a first look: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad's demo Is here!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

[b]FINALLY[/b] we can show you what we’ve been working on for these last few years! It took a bit longer than we planned, based on our usual game release schedule, but now you can see what we've been cooking!

We would love, love, LOVE for you to give the demo a try. It'll show you about 30 minutes of what the game has to offer — the frantic action, the upbeat humour, and the loveable cast of characters we've created for you. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/][b]> Download it from the game's main page[/b][/url]

[h2]Some notes about the demo:[/h2]
[list]
[*]A DualSense, DualShock, or Xbox controller is recommended (there's some weirdness with Switch Pro controllers right now that will be fixed)
[*]The demo can be played in up to native 4K!
[*]There may be some weirdness with windowed mode right now; we'll fix that too
[*]The demo lets you fail treatment scenes with no penalty; we just want you to have fun; you can stress out in the full game
[/list]

[h2]We made a wholesome game!?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097922/7ac4b21d936e8bcb70ed4afc291616b5aa6d9842.png[/img]

We're super excited that Neo Harbor Rescue Squad joins the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/url]. 🎉

For those who’ve played our previous games, you’ll notice a change in tone, and there’s a reason for that.
This game was conceived during the height of the pandemic. Initially, we were going to channel that into a dark mystery, just like our other games, but we struggled to make it fun. Maybe it was because neither of us had the mental capacity during those uncertain times. Eventually, we tried a different angle. We added a cast of colorful characters, including a smack-talking dolphin (don’t ask); that’s when we knew we’d hit the right note. 

So please enjoy this demo! Tell your friends, smack that wishlist button, etc. etc. — and thanks for your continued support. 🙏

Ben & Nancy
